subject: Medify evaluation: concordance targets, exit gates, and test plan
messages:
From: Emma O'Connor <emma.oconnor@medifyhealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Andy Li <andy.li@medifyhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up — MAP and acceptance criteria

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our clinical search team is ready to run a 6-week eval but we need a mutual action plan with concrete success targets and the acceptance tests we will run. Two things matter most for us:

- Concordance with our gold set (we use pairwise labels) — we need >0.88 recall for primary intent at the end of the eval.
- Production-like latency under load — target p95 <= 350ms at 500 QPS sustained.

Can the MAP include owner assignments for each test (engineering, security, CS), cutover criteria, and a go/no-go checklist for the final week? Also we will need a signed timeline to get procurement moving.

Emma
Senior PM, Medify Health

--
Medify Health | emma.oconnor@medifyhealth.com
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Emma O'Connor <emma.oconnor@medifyhealth.com>
Cc: Andy Li <andy.li@medifyhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up — MAP and acceptance criteria

Emma — thanks, this is helpful. Draft MAP attached (Medify_MAP_v1.xlsx) and below is a concise acceptance plan we propose. I kept items narrow so we can iterate quickly.

Summary (proposed):
- Eval window: 6 weeks (pilot traffic + synthetic stress window in weeks 4–5).
- Primary success signals:
  1) Concordance (primary intent recall) >= 0.88 on the gold set (week 6 final evaluation).
  2) Response quality: average human rating >= 4.0/5 on 200 blind samples (week 5 review).
  3) Latency SLO: p95 <= 350ms at 500 sustained QPS; burst to 800 QPS with graceful tail latency (week 4 stress test).
- Exit gates (must pass all): security review cleared, data residency validated, concordance and latency thresholds met, regression tests pass on 1k sample prompts.
- Acceptance tests (owners):
  - Concordance run: Medify to provide gold set; Redwood to run evaluation and share script + results (owner: Stephanie / Medify analytics).
  - Latency/stress: Redwood infra to run synthetic load (owner: Ben).
  - Quality survey: Medify annotators to rate 200 samples; Redwood to blind and randomize (owner: Andy / Stephanie).
- Final cutover: week 7 can be scheduled if all gates pass; otherwise a single 2-week remediation sprint is allowed.

Attached: draft MAP + our smoke test checklist (redwood-smoke-tests.md) and a latency runbook.

Next step: if this looks good, can you confirm owners and sign the MAP so procurement can issue the PO? I can also add a short canary plan for production pinning.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Medify MAP — owners and test details

Quick internal note — key asks from Medify and what I want us to own:

- Concordance evaluation: Medify will provide gold set (they called it pairwise labels). We need an evaluation script that outputs recall/precision and per-intent breakdown. Deliverable: Jupyter + CSV of labeled results. Owner: Ben (analytics) — deadline: week 2.

- Latency/stress runs: Run bench that simulates 500 QPS sustained and 800 burst for 15min. Measure p95, p99, and tail latency. Also include KV cache warmup scenario with 30% token overlap. Owner: Jordan (infra). Run in week 4.

- Quality survey: We will randomize 200 samples and blind them. Need to produce sampling RNG seed and provide instructions to Medify annotators. Owner: Stephanie.

- Security evidence: standard SOC2 + data residency note. Ask Security for an attest doc (I will loop in if needed).

Action items for us: Ben: evaluation script template; Jordan: perf harness + runbook; Steph: finalize MAP, confirm owners in spreadsheet, send back to Emma.

I will attach the draft smoke-tests in the external reply; keep the internal notes here for the ticket.

Thanks — Steph
From: Emma O'Connor <emma.oconnor@medifyhealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Andy Li <andy.li@medifyhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 10:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up — MAP and acceptance criteria

Stephanie — this is great, thanks for the structured plan. A couple of small tweaks from our side:

1) Concordance target: can we add a mid-eval threshold at week 3 of >= 0.82 recall so we can catch major regressions early?
2) Latency: we will also need a cold-start scenario (p95 <= 450ms after 30min idle) to reflect our low-frequency workflow for some endpoints.
3) Security: we need a short note in the MAP about retention limits for dev logs (30 days) and that audit logs are retained separately.

We confirmed owners internally: Andy will coordinate annotators for the quality survey and will own the gold set delivery (expected by Mon, 31 Aug). If you can update the MAP with the mid-eval threshold and cold-start measurement, we can sign and loop procurement.

Emma

--
Emma O'Connor | Medify Health
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Emma O'Connor <emma.oconnor@medifyhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Andy Li <andy.li@medifyhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 16:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up — MAP and acceptance criteria (finalized)

Emma / Andy — thanks, updates applied and MAP attached (final v1). Key changes incorporated:

- Added Week 3 mid-eval concordance checkpoint: recall >= 0.82 (blocking for continuation).
- Added cold-start latency test: p95 <= 450ms after 30min idle; included test script in latency-runbook.pdf.
- Security note: dev-log retention capped at 30 days; audit logs retained per SOC2 template.

High-level timeline (attached MAP):
- Week 0 (sign + PO): procurement issues PO upon signature.
- Weeks 1–2: onboarding, gold set delivery (Medify), evaluation script delivery (Ben).
- Weeks 3–5: live pilot + synthetic stress in week 4. Mid-eval checkpoint at end of week 3.
- Week 6: final evaluation and quality survey.
- Week 7: cutover window (if all gates pass) or remediation sprint.

Next steps: Emma to confirm PO timing; Andy to deliver gold set by 2026-08-31. Ben/Jordan to confirm they have compute reserved for the week 4 stress run. Once PO is confirmed I will circulate the signed MAP doc for procurement.

Attachments: Medify_MAP_v1.xlsx, redwood-smoke-tests.md, latency-runbook.pdf

Thanks everyone — looking forward to running this.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
